papers.title: LENS: Replacing LayerNorm and Softmax in Transformers with Learnable Normalization States
papers.ko_title: LENS 학습 가능한 정규화 상태로 LayerNorm과 Softmax를 대체하는 트랜스포머 구조
papers.summary: 트랜스포머에서 하드웨어 가속 효율을 저해하는 LayerNorm과 어텐션 Softmax를 소형 MLP 기반의 학습 가능한 정규화 상태로 재정식화해 GEMM 연산 비중을 높입니다.
papers.abstract: LayerNorm and attention Softmax are critical operations in Transformers. However, they cannot be efficiently mapped to General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) computations on hardware. Therefore, modern hardware accelerator designs, such as NPUs on ASIC/FPGA, consume a large amount of hardware resources or chip area to implement their specific arithmetic units. Building on previous work about LayerNorm, Softmax, and their alternatives, we introduce Learnable Normalization States (LENS), a framework that reformulates LayerNorm as tiny MLPs by abstracting a common structure from related methods and extends this method to Softmax, which moves more of the computation in Transformers to GEMM as a hardware-friendly architecture. We evaluate LENS on image classification with Vision Transformers (ViT) and autoregressive language modeling with Pythia models, including generalization tests on WikiText and LAMBADA. Across these tasks, LENS matches or exceeds baseline performance in several vision settings and retains most of the baseline performance in the remaining vision and language experiments. These findings may suggest that hand-designed normalization and attention functions are not the only choice as alternatives to LayerNorm and Softmax. LENS also provides a basis for exploring Transformer architectures for resource-limited accelerators.

papers.title: Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models
papers.ko_title: Weights & Caches 역전파 없이 표 형식 파운데이션 모델의 가중치를 직접 프로그래밍하는 LLM
papers.summary: LLM이 경사 기반 최적화 없이 영(0)으로 초기화된 nanoTabPFN의 가중치를 직접 프로그래밍해 20개 TabArena 데이터셋에서 평균 ROC AUC 0.849를 달성하며 가중치 공간 프로그래밍을 입증합니다.
papers.abstract: Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. Second, Astra diagnoses and repairs a signed-product regression failure in pretrained TabPFN-3.5, restoring near-perfect predictions on held-out synthetic datasets while preserving performance on TabArena-Lite, with only a 0.08% average relative increase in error. Third, it writes KV-cache-editing programs that steer TabPFN-3.5's predictions on unseen synthetic datasets, demonstrating transformations such as reversing linear trends and converting sine waves into approximate square waves, without modifying model weights. Together, our findings suggest that LLM-driven programming could complement gradient-based optimization across TFMs' development and usage, while offering a new way to investigate and intervene in their internal computations.

papers.title: Protecting Safety during Reasoning Training with Low-Rank Fisher Regularisation
papers.ko_title: 저랭크 Fisher 정규화로 추론 학습 과정의 모델 안전성 저하 방어
papers.summary: 추론 능력 등 신규 역량을 파인튜닝할 때 발생하는 안전 가드레일 훼손을 막기 위해 파라미터 간 상호작용을 무시하는 기존 대각 EWC 대신 저랭크 Fisher 정보 행렬 정규화를 제안합니다.
papers.abstract: Large language models are trained to have safety guardrails, but these can be compromised while fine-tuning for new capabilities, such as reasoning. One way to mitigate this degradation is to modify the fine-tuning objective to preserve safety behaviour, but doing so effectively and efficiently remains challenging. We revisit Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which penalises parameter updates based on sensitivity estimates from the diagonal of the Fisher information matrix (FIM). While EWC provides some protection, the diagonal approximation ignores interactions between parameters. We address this limitation by exploiting recent findings that safety-relevant behaviour is located in a low-rank subspace within models. Our method, Subspace-Projected Elastic Weight Consolidation (SP-EWC), projects gradients onto this subspace to capture non-diagonal curvature efficiently. We investigate three different ways of identifying the safety subspace: through safety fine-tuning updates (LoRA), safety-related activations (ActSVD), and contrastive representations of safety and utility data (cPCA). We find that this choice substantially affects performance, with SP-EWC using cPCA comparing favourably against existing methods by better maintaining safety guardrails without introducing excessive over-refusal.

papers.title: AI and the Two Margins of Work: Why Job Losses Show Up Before Job Creation
papers.ko_title: AI 혁신과 노동의 두 경로 일자리 파괴가 창출보다 먼저 통계에 잡히는 이유
papers.summary: 기술 혁신 과정에서 기존 기업의 일자리 감축은 급여 통계에 즉각 포착되는 반면 신규 기업의 일자리 창출은 상당한 시차를 두고 반영됨을 역사적 데이터와 이론 모형으로 규명합니다.
papers.abstract: Technological change acts on labor demand at two margins: adjustment within established activities and the creation of additional activities, often by new firms. Payroll statistics record the first promptly and the second late. In the computing era, firms that entered in 1978 or later held 42 percent of payroll by 1998 and entering cohorts kept about 80 percent of their payroll after five years; in the industries most exposed to automation, incumbents contracted before entrants accumulated, a sequence that is precise early in the period and suggestive by its end. We develop a model in which one AI capability lowers the full cost of acceptable output in existing production and makes additional projects worth attempting, with founder effort separate from hired hours. If operating products re-scale instantly, automation displaces no aggregate hours; if they take time, hours fall first and recover as incumbents re-expand and new products arrive, with the long-run sign set by income effects. Establishment job flows through the first quarter of 2026 show no gradient on language-model exposure on either margin, which is what the model predicts under the observed adoption path and also what no effect on payroll would look like; studies with founding-task exposure find entry rising 10 to 20 percent. We propose a net reinstatement ratio and show that statistics which record new work late overstate displacement for years.

papers.title: Huge If True: Learning from the Size of the Surprise
papers.ko_title: 서프라이즈 크기가 주는 정보 실적 충격과 밸류에이션 불확실성에 따른 시장 반응
papers.summary: 투자자가 어닝 서프라이즈의 크기로부터 충격 자체뿐 아니라 기업가치 평가 승수까지 동시에 학습하여 불확실성이 높을수록 평균 반응은 둔화되되 미세한 서프라이즈에는 더 가파르게 반응함을 밝힙니다.
papers.abstract: Responses to earnings surprises depend on an unknown multiplier mapping earnings to value. Investors, however, learn about the news and the multiplier from the same number. Large surprises may indicate small multipliers and tiny surprises large ones. We model how greater uncertainty about the multiplier attenuates responses on average but makes them steeper near zero surprises. In an incentivized experiment, we find that greater processing constraints lower average sensitivity but raise it near zero. We confirm this with real-world earnings announcements: stocks with higher valuation uncertainty, our proxy for multiplier uncertainty, respond less on average but more steeply near zero.

papers.title: Data-center growth impacts household electricity costs more through wholesale prices than through grid reinforcement
papers.ko_title: 데이터센터 증설이 가계 전력 요금에 미치는 영향 송전망 확충보다 전력 도매가격 상승이 핵심 경로
papers.summary: 대규모 데이터센터 증설이 주택용 전기요금에 미치는 영향을 전력 시스템 모형으로 분석하여 요금 인상 요인의 68%가 송전망 보강 비용이 아닌 도매 전력 가격 상승에서 기인함을 입증합니다.
papers.abstract: Rapid data-center expansion is raising concerns about electricity affordability, yet how the costs of serving these large new loads reach residential customers remains poorly understood. Here, we quantify the potential impact of 371 announced Texas data-center projects, totaling 38.9 GW by 2030, on residential electricity costs by linking power system expansion, wholesale electricity markets, transmission reinforcement, and retail cost allocation. We find that accommodating this demand increases modeled residential electricity costs in one representative case by 1.64 cents/kWh, with 68% arising from higher wholesale electricity prices and 32% from regulated transmission charges. Allowing new gas generation near data centers reduces the 2023 residential cost increase to 0.92 cents/kWh, whereas excluding data centers from the transmission cost-sharing base raises it to 1.87 cents/kWh. These findings reveal that the residential cost burden of data-center growth is driven primarily by wholesale electricity price increases, rather than direct transmission investment costs, and depends critically on generation siting, infrastructure planning, and cost allocation.

papers.title: FETTUCCINE: Fast and efficient brain-to-text decoding on mobile devices
papers.ko_title: FETTUCCINE 모바일 기기 기반의 실시간 고속 뇌-텍스트 디코딩 기술
papers.summary: 기존 음성 인공보철 시스템의 막대한 연산 비용과 지연 시간 문제를 극복하여 모바일 기기에서도 일상 대화가 가능한 실시간 뇌-텍스트 변환을 구현합니다.
papers.abstract: Recent advances in speech neuroprostheses have enabled new communication avenues for people who have lost the ability to speak due to neurological illness or injury. These systems can decode neural activity during attempted speech into text by relying on language priors to achieve high decoding accuracy. This performance currently comes at the cost of using a compute-intensive language modeling stack, presenting a major bottleneck for real-world use. Further, current language models incur highly variable and disruptive inference latencies, limiting communication throughput and preventing users from reliably participating in natural conversation. We introduce FETTUCCINE, an end-to-end brain-to-text framework that leverages the speed and portability of automatic speech recognition (ASR) models to address the aforementioned practical challenges, while achieving usable (<10%) word error rates (WER), efficient adaptation to neural non-stationarities, and reliable performance on mobile devices. When evaluated using publicly available data from an intracortical speech neuroprosthesis user, FETTUCCINE outperforms previous end-to-end methods, achieving as low as 4.39% WER. Most notably, our models successfully run on a commercially-available mobile device with throughput reaching up to 370x real-time, providing the first demonstration of brain-to-text decoding on a mobile device. We also show that our models can be successfully finetuned to extend usable performance to future days. Beyond performance, our approach enables localization of the neural features most relevant for decoding via gradient-based saliency maps, which we show align with well-established physiological priors across different ASR model families. Taken together, our results show that FETTUCCINE overcomes core infrastructural and computational barriers, yielding a new class of portable brain-to-text communication.

papers.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
papers.ko_title: Bonbon 거대 분자 상호작용 파운데이션 모델의 창발적 생물학 분석 역량
papers.summary: 3조 2천억 토큰 규모의 단백질-리간드 서열 학습을 통해 약물 작용 기전 규명과 결합 부위 식별을 추가 학습 없이 수행하는 창발적 제로샷 예측 능력을 입증합니다.
papers.abstract: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.

papers.title: BioMARS 2.0: a robotic biologist for formulating and adapting biological experiments
papers.ko_title: BioMARS 2.0 가설 수립과 적응형 실험 수행을 결합한 자율형 로봇 생물학자
papers.summary: 생물학 지식 기반의 의사결정과 로봇 자동화 하드웨어 및 세포 피드백을 유기적으로 연동하여 실험 설계부터 최적화까지 전 주기를 자율적으로 수행합니다.
papers.abstract: Biological experimentation is not reducible to a single optimization problem, but requires decisions at multiple levels of abstraction: translating scientific knowledge into experimental procedures, adapting culture conditions to measured phenotypes and selecting interventions that test biological hypotheses. Automating experimental execution does not, by itself, determine which experiments should be performed next or how they should change in response to biological feedback. Here we introduce BioMARS, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent robotic system that connects knowledge-guided experimental decision-making with robotic execution and biological feedback. At the procedural level, BioMARS generated literature-grounded protocols and traceable action plans, improving expert-reviewed protocol quality scores across four model backends. At the parametric level, BioMARS used image-derived phenotypes from robotic retinal organoid culture to select subsequent experimental conditions, with higher reported scores in later rounds of the three-round experiment. At the intervention level, BioMARS nominated drug-repurposing candidates from biomedical evidence and advanced six candidates to wet-lab testing by researchers. Together, these studies demonstrate feedback-driven robotic biological experimentation within a framework that supports decisions about experimental procedures, culture conditions and biological interventions.

papers.title: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
papers.ko_title: 에이전틱 AI를 활용한 내결함성 양자 회로의 자동 설계 및 탐색
papers.summary: 대규모 언어 모델 기반 에이전트와 회로 검증기를 결합하여 수작업에 의존하던 내결함성 양자 회로 설계를 진화적 프로그램 합성 방식으로 자동화합니다.
papers.abstract: Scaling quantum computing toward practical quantum advantage is currently limited by the efficiency of circuits that operate on information encoded by quantum error-correcting codes. The full stack of quantum computing encompasses several tasks: preparation of logical code states, implementation of logical gates, logical routines on encoded qubits, etc. Yet, these circuits are largely designed by hand for individual cases, with some recent works incorporating machine learning for certain aspects. We formulate this problem as agentic evolutionary program synthesis, wherein a large language model, leveraging its pretraining knowledge and tool-use proficiency, and guided by a circuit verifier, evolves a program that defines a Clifford circuit for a wide range of curated tasks such as logical state preparation, logical gate design, and logical routines such as code-switching, code growth, etc. Our approach consistently finds fault-tolerant circuits for all of these tasks, each verified by an exhaustive check over faults.

papers.title: Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
papers.ko_title: 나트륨 이온 배터리의 하드카본 계면 반응을 정밀 모사하는 원자 파운데이션 모델 미세조정
papers.summary: MACE 기반 원자 파운데이션 모델을 미세조정하여 복잡한 나트륨-하드카본 구조의 화학 반응을 밀도범함수이론 수준의 정확도로 효율적으로 시뮬레이션합니다.
papers.abstract: Atomistic foundation models have emerged as a promising route to DFT-level accuracy for materials simulation with complex chemical environments. However, their reliability across competing bonding regimes and, more importantly, how complex bonding affects predictions of material properties remain unclear. Among materials with competing bonding regimes, sodium storage in hard carbon poses a substantial challenge. Hard carbon features diverse local structural motifs, including defective and curved graphitic regions, amorphous regions, and closed/open pores. Motivated by its importance for Na-ion batteries, we systematically evaluate existing pretrained foundation models based on the MACE architecture across different local Na/C motifs. We find that the pretrained models fail to accurately capture Na-Na and Na-C interactions for metallic Na clusters on graphene. To recover a DFT-level energetic description, we employ targeted fine-tuning, showing that it can describe the energetic stability of local motifs and achieve sufficient transferability to unseen Na/C environments. With the developed fine-tuned model, we establish a correlation between closed-pore radius in hard carbon and plateau voltage, showing that the small pores contribute at larger voltages than large ones, suggesting thus how the developed fine-tuned foundation model can link atomistic information with materials design for complex bonding environments.

papers.title: Structure makes quantum circuits trainable
papers.ko_title: 양자 회로의 대칭 구조 분석을 통한 바렌 플래토 극복과 학습 가능성 증명
papers.summary: 콤팩트 리 군의 유니터리 표현 분해를 활용하여 변분 양자 회로의 기울기 소실 여부를 판별하고 양자 머신러닝 모델의 학습 가능성을 해석적으로 증명합니다.
papers.abstract: The scalability of variational quantum algorithms is limited by barren plateaus, where gradients vanish exponentially in system size. This worst-case result raises fundamental questions about the trainability of quantum AI models. We present a major advance towards resolving this trainability question by answering whether a given quantum circuit has a barren plateau. We do this using an analytical framework that bounds the gradient variance for arbitrary input states $ρ$ and observables $\mathcal{M}$ by decomposing the unitary representation of the associated compact Lie group. When the circuit segments on both sides of a gate form $2$-designs, we obtain the variance exactly and prove a sufficient condition for trainability: if $ρ^{\otimes 2}$ and $\mathcal{M}^{\otimes 2}$ are sufficiently concentrated on the same irreducible invariant subspace of polynomial dimension, and the differentiated gate moves this subspace by an inverse-polynomial amount, then the gradient variance is at least inverse-polynomial. We further present a sampling algorithm that estimates the gradient variance from runs of the ansatz, without constructing the representation-theoretic projectors. Our algorithm decides whether the variance exceeds a tolerance $τ$ with the number of runs polynomial in $1/τ$, including cases in which the bounds are inconclusive. This resolves the question of the trainability of the circuit before expensive training procedures.

papers.title: Hinted Scaling Laws
papers.ko_title: 힌트 기반 스케일링 법칙 소형 모델의 한계를 넘는 다운스트림 성능 예측
papers.summary: 소형 모델이 0점에 가까운 점수를 얻는 어려운 벤치마크에서도 단계별 힌트를 제공해 연속적인 난이도 스펙트럼을 구축함으로써 대규모 학습의 다운스트림 성능을 정확히 예측하는 새로운 스케일링 법칙을 제안합니다.
papers.abstract: Scaling laws predict the outcome of large, expensive training runs by extrapolating trends from smaller, cheaper runs. On downstream accuracy evaluations, these predictions fail when the weaker models produced by the cheaper runs score near zero accuracy, because these scores give no trend to extrapolate to larger scales. We introduce hinted scaling laws, which use privileged information to turn a benchmark into a continuum of easier versions so that even the small models score above zero. We find that accuracy rises smoothly and predictably with the hint level, enabling new types of scaling laws that operate below the noise threshold. On the Delphi pretraining ladder, a hinted scaling law fit on models trained with at most $10^{20}$ FLOPs forecasts the GSM8K accuracy of a $10^{23}$ FLOP model (25.9%) to within 3 percentage points; a standard scaling law under-forecasts it by 13 percentage points when fit on the same models and by 12 even with models up to $10^{22}$ FLOPs in the fit. Across both this pretraining ladder and a collection of post-trained model families, hinted scaling laws reduce the median forecasting error on GSM8K, AIME and HLE from 21 percentage points to 4.3. Hinting also reduces the number of test examples needed to tell whether one model is better than another by widening the accuracy gaps between models while approximately preserving their order: a single hinted rollout per problem ranks nearly indistinguishable models as accurately as five unhinted rollouts. Our results suggest that hinting is a general primitive for improving the accuracy and cost of downstream scaling laws and other prediction tasks in model development.

papers.title: Concise-9B: Removing the Slack from a Reasoning Model's Thinking
papers.ko_title: Concise-9B 추론 모델의 사고 과정에서 불필요한 군더더기 제거하기
papers.summary: 온폴리시 기각 샘플링 미세조정을 통해 추론 모델이 정답 도출 후에도 불필요하게 이어가는 사고 과정을 제거하여 정확도 손실 없이 생성 토큰 수를 34% 절감합니다.
papers.abstract: Reasoning models answer better when they think longer, but a thinking trace keeps going well after its answer has formed. We measure this slack in Qwen3.5-9B and remove most of it with concise self-training: two rounds of on-policy rejection-sampling fine-tuning that keep the shortest correct samples, plus a small share of answer-synthesis targets, giving Concise-9B. On 8,983 held-out problems (competition and hard mathematics, SuperGPQA, a five-area confirmation set and MMLU-Pro), Concise-9B generates 0.66x the tokens of Qwen3.5-9B at a 32K thinking budget, with accuracy equivalent within +/-1 point (-0.20 [-0.77, +0.36] points). Forcing each trace on the hard and confirmation sets to answer every 2,048 thinking tokens, we find that 54-64% of Qwen3.5-9B's thinking tokens come after the point from which every forced answer equals the final one (41-48% for Concise-9B). Stopping there would keep every answer at 0.35-0.44x the base model's tokens, but finding that point takes hindsight: stopping when three consecutive forced answers agree costs the base model 2.4-9.2 points. Concise self-training removes slack without that cost: 86% [83, 90] of the thinking tokens it saves come after the answer has formed. It has a limit: with traces continued to 80K tokens, Concise-9B solves 25 fewer of 1,276 hard problems (-25 [-49, -1]), mostly in competition mathematics. The measurement also yields a cheap commit signal for adaptive sampling that matched two-sample escalation within +/-1 point at 0.67x its tokens in a pre-registered test. Results on Qwen3.5-4B, on which the recipe was developed, and a replication on Olmo-3-7B-Think suggest that the saving depends on how verbose the base model is.

papers.title: Who Should Score the Cache? Mid-Depth Layers Are the Best Judges of KV-Cache Eviction
papers.ko_title: 누가 캐시를 평가해야 하는가 KV 캐시 퇴출의 최적 심판관인 중간 깊이 레이어
papers.summary: 21개 언어 모델을 분석하여 각 레이어가 자체 KV 캐시를 평가하는 기존 방식 대신 전체 깊이의 40~75%에 위치한 중간 레이어의 어텐션 점수를 활용해야 장문맥 검색 정확도가 극대화됨을 규명합니다.
papers.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache eviction methods rank tokens by attention scores, and each layer scores its own cache. To our knowledge, no eviction method asks which layer should score. We find, across twenty-one models, that the depth of the scoring layer governs eviction quality. On the eighteen models with per-layer caches, spanning 0.5B to 109B, long-context retrieval accuracy collapses at shallow layers, peaks between 0.4 and 0.75 of depth, and degrades at the last layer. The curve arises because a layer judges tokens well only once it has used the question to find the answer, which takes several layers. Modeling eviction as a top-$k$ cut, we compute answer survival probability from prefill attention and reproduce the measured curves. This approach selects the scoring layer using calibration prompts with known answers, and the selected layer is the best layer measured on most models and never significantly below it. It improves on the own-layer default on sixteen of the eighteen models, with significant gains on seven, all at 14B or below, while on larger models the default is already close to the best mid-depth layer. Scoring every cache from the selected layer while keeping one set of tokens for all heads also beats per-head SnapKV by 18 to 43 points on five models up to 14B under tight budgets. This gain carries over to financial filings at 32K context, all at the same memory budget, with no extra forward pass. The same curve explains a penalty in shared-cache models, where several layers read one cache and the layer that writes it scores by default. On Gemma-4-E2B the writer is shallow and loses 28 points to a mid-depth reader at a 10% budget. We also find that in open-book question answering (LongBench) no mid-depth layer beats the own-layer default.

papers.title: Organizing Intelligence
papers.ko_title: 지능의 조직화 AI 역량과 기업 생산성 및 시장 구조의 변화
papers.summary: 인간과 달리 복제 가능하고 조정 한계가 다른 AI의 특성이 기업의 역량 결합과 균형 시장 구조를 어떻게 근본적으로 변화시키는지 이론적으로 규명합니다.
papers.abstract: When will advances in AI lead to economic transformation? We develop a model of how intelligence, the ability to achieve goals, matters for organizations, the key unit of economic production. Agents (human or AI) with multidimensional capabilities sort endogenously into competing firms. A firm's productivity depends on its agents' capabilities; we distinguish competence, which shifts productivity levels, from coordination, which governs how productivity scales with size. Two differences between AI and humans drive transformation: AI expertise is reproducible while humans' are in fixed supply, and AIs may not face the same human limits on coordination. We analyze how equilibrium market structure, productivity, employment, and wages evolve as AI capabilities improve. When AI is more capable than the average human, organizations of complementary humans can nonetheless outperform AI. Increases in AI competence can change the composition of workers within firms and decrease firm size. As AI coordination improves, however, this can break the Coasean ceiling on firm size and the market structure undergoes a phase transition toward large, concentrated AI-heavy firms. Changes in human employment are gradual when AI displaces workers within mixed human-AI firms, or sudden when AI firms outcompete human firms. We decompose wage changes into a technology effect, which changes the value of humans within existing firms, and a reorganization effect as firms adjust size and composition. Reorganization can reverse the technology effect on wages.

papers.title: How Different are Different Differences-in-Differences? A Large-Scale Meta-Analysis
papers.ko_title: 이중차분법(DiD) 추정량들은 실제로 얼마나 다른가 대규모 메타 분석
papers.summary: 경제학 논문 116편의 1,430개 시차 도입 모형을 AI 기반으로 재현하여 전통적 이원고정효과(TWFE)와 최신 이중차분법 추정치 간의 높은 상관관계와 실증적 일관성을 입증합니다.
papers.abstract: I use AI-assisted replication to assess the empirical importance of negative weights in two-way fixed effects (TWFE) estimation, analyzing 1,430 staggered-adoption specifications from 116 economics papers. TWFE estimates are highly correlated with modern difference-in-differences estimates, with sign reversals in 12.0-14.9% of comparisons and greater precision for TWFE. Hierarchical models accounting for estimation noise imply estimand correlations of 91-97% and a 0.7-2.4% probability of a statistically significant TWFE estimate opposing the modern estimand's sign. These findings suggest negative weights may be a less serious problem in practice and illustrate how AI can support systematic, large-scale empirical assessments of new econometric methods.

papers.title: Does Calibration Pick the Right Model? Likelihood Evidence from Income Risk
papers.ko_title: 캘리브레이션은 올바른 모형을 선택하는가 소득 위험의 우도 기반 실증 분석
papers.summary: 거시경제학의 관행적인 적률 매칭 캘리브레이션이 전체 소득 이력 데이터를 설명하는 데 한계가 있음을 유한상태 은닉 마르코프 근사를 통한 우도 추정으로 보여줍니다.
papers.abstract: Quantitative macroeconomics typically disciplines models by matching selected moments. We show how finite-state hidden Markov approximations make likelihood estimation and model selection feasible for nonlinear, non-Gaussian latent processes on short panels, without simulation. We illustrate the method with PSID earnings data. The calibrations that best match moments of earnings dynamics fit complete histories worse than a likelihood-estimated process with a Gaussian persistent component. In a standard saving model, calibrations of one process that fit the targets about equally well imply mean assets that differ by a factor of three. Close agreement with selected moments can leave economic predictions largely undetermined.

papers.title: Evolutionary characterization of whole-genome doubling across human cancers
papers.ko_title: 인간 암 전반에 걸친 전장 유전체 배수화의 진화적 특성 규명
papers.summary: 12종 암의 종양 4만여 개를 다중오믹스로 통합 분석하여 전장 유전체 배수화(WGD) 전후의 주요 변이 시점과 염색체 손실 패턴의 진화적 원리를 규명합니다.
papers.abstract: Whole-genome doubling (WGD) is common across human cancers and is associated with tumour progression and adverse clinical outcomes. However, how genome-doubled tumours evolve across diverse cancer types remains poorly understood. Here we characterize WGD-associated tumour evolution by integrating genomic analyses of 41,332 tumours from 12 cancer types with evolutionary timing and multi-omic data. Several canonical driver mutations generally preceded WGD when both occurred, as did the onset of homologous recombination deficiency-associated mutagenesis. Notably, post-WGD chromosome-arm losses showed substantially weaker cancer-type dependence than pre-WGD losses, with 61-75% less variance explained by cancer type. Beyond chromosomal evolution, WGD+ tumours showed reduced interferon-response and HLA antigen-presentation programmes linked to epigenetic remodelling, without disproportionate enrichment of genetic immune-escape alterations. Our findings highlight WGD as a recurrent evolutionary transition associated with altered chromosomal evolution and epigenetically linked immune adaptation across cancers.

papers.title: Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context
papers.ko_title: 세포 계보 맥락을 활용한 발생 역학 학습
papers.summary: 트리 구조 트랜스포머와 확률적 보간법을 결합한 계보 인페인팅 기법으로 마우스 배아 발생 과정의 세포 상태 역학과 전사적 수렴 현상을 복원합니다.
papers.abstract: A central goal of biology is to predict the dynamics of multicellular systems. Lineage context (the states of a cell's sisters, cousins, etc.) could inform these predictions, but how best to leverage it remains unclear. Here we introduce lineage inpainting, a generative modeling approach that uses lineage context with tree-structured transformers and stochastic interpolants to model cell state dynamics across lineage trees. Applied to a lineage-traced transcriptional atlas of mouse embryogenesis, it recovers dynamics not resolved by gene expression alone, including multiple transcriptional convergence events where distinct lineages are drawn to a common state. Despite being fit on unperturbed development, lineage inpainting can generate hypotheses about perturbation responses by simulating counterfactuals. These simulations agree in many cases with observed developmental phenotypes, including a single-cell measurement of the Tbx5 knockout response. Our results show that lineage information provides a rich source of context for learning multicellular dynamics.

papers.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
papers.ko_title: HELICS 잠재 플로우 매칭 기반의 바이오뱅크 규모 조건부 합성 유전체 생성
papers.summary: 위상 정보 없이도 수백만 개의 상관된 단일염기다형성(SNP) 분포를 학습하여 개인정보 보호와 소수 집단 보강을 지원하는 고충실도 합성 유전체를 생성합니다.
papers.abstract: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

papers.title: Boson sampling is fragile to loss
papers.ko_title: 광자 손실에 취약한 보손 샘플링의 양자 우위 한계 규명
papers.summary: 아무리 작은 비율의 균일한 광자 손실이라도 존재하면 고전 컴퓨터로 보손 샘플링을 평균적으로 효율적 모사할 수 있음을 증명하여 실험적 양자 우위 달성의 근본적 한계를 제시합니다.
papers.abstract: Boson sampling experiments aim to demonstrate quantum computational advantage with increasing numbers of interfering photons. A central question is whether their computational hardness survives under photon loss. We show that even an arbitrarily small nonzero uniform loss rate permits efficient classical sampling in the average case when the rate remains fixed as the system grows. We exploit how loss suppresses correlations involving many photons to approximate the full output distribution using low correlation orders. The resulting samplers run in time polynomial in system size and inverse total variation error, with the error averaged over Haar random interferometers. The results apply to Fock state boson sampling with single-photon states in distinct input modes and arbitrary additional vacuum inputs, and to Gaussian boson sampling with equal squeezing of bounded strength in every input mode. Classical sampling is efficient even when the mean detected photon number grows linearly with system size, showing that large photon counts alone do not ensure computational hardness.

papers.title: Near-Optimal Learning of Quantum Many-Body Systems from Gibbs and Thermal Metastable States via the Stationarity Test
papers.ko_title: 정상성 테스트를 통한 양자 다체계 해밀토니안의 준최적 학습 알고리즘
papers.summary: 깁스 상태와 열적 준안정 상태로부터 양자 다체계의 해밀토니안을 역온도에 대해 기존보다 획기적으로 개선된 지수 선형 복잡도로 학습하는 준최적 알고리즘을 제안합니다.
papers.abstract: We study the problem of learning a finite-range quantum Hamiltonian on an $n$-qubit $D$-dimensional lattice from copies of its Gibbs states at a known inverse temperature $β$ or its thermal metastable states. Existing efficient algorithms at arbitrary temperature have sample guarantees with an $e^{\poly(β)}$ dependence, leaving open whether the exponent can be made linear in $β$. We achieve this improvement: for $β\ge1$, our algorithm learns all Hamiltonian coefficients to $\ell_\infty$-error $ε$ with probability at least $1-δ$ using $\tO\bigl(e^{O(β)}ε^{-2}\log(n/δ)\bigr)$ copies and total time $\tO\bigl(n e^{O(β)}ε^{-2}\log(n/δ)\bigr)$. The measurements act on individual copies and are supported on balls of radius $O\bigl(β^2+β\log(1/ε)\bigr)$. Our sample complexity achieves the optimal exponential order in $β$, with optimal $ε^{-2}$ dependence up to logarithmic factors. Building on the stationarity-test framework \citep{Bergamaschi2026Stationarity}, we prove a unified Fisher-information coercivity bound showing that errors in the candidate Hamiltonian produce a detectable signal with only an $e^{-O(β)}$ loss in sensitivity. The key is a smooth frequency filter whose bandwidth remains independent of temperature, together with sharper estimates relating this signal to the Hamiltonian coefficients. For thermal metastable states, the guarantee holds under local drift $ζ\le e^{-Cβ^{2D+1}}$, for a geometry-dependent constant $C>0$, and above an accuracy floor $\tO(e^{O(β)}ζ)$. The argument applies to both Gibbs and thermal metastable states and, combined with local measurements and projected stochastic gradient descent (SGD), yields both learning guarantees.

papers.title: Statistical mechanics of spontaneous behavior
papers.ko_title: 자발적 동물 행동의 통계역학적 법칙 규명
papers.summary: 동물이 특정 행동에 머무는 시간의 분포가 제약 조건에 도달할 때까지의 지속 시간만으로 결정되며 볼츠만 법칙과 열역학 법칙을 따른다는 사실을 초파리 실험으로 입증합니다.
papers.abstract: Why do a few behaviors fill most of an animal's time? The usual answer is that these behaviors are started more often, because learning and reinforcement favor them. Here we show that how long a behavior lasts can, by itself, explain much of what is observed. We consider a system that runs until it meets a constraint, such as a wall, and then resets. The fraction of time it spends in each behavior then follows the Boltzmann law, and the partition function is the mean time between resets. The four laws of thermodynamics follow as theorems from four postulates, and critical points that act as bottlenecks become the most occupied states. In 47 multi-day recordings of fruit flies, the dominant behavior accounts for only $13\%$ of bout starts yet fills $49\%$ of the time, and its typical duration identifies the individual fly. These results lay the groundwork for a statistical mechanics of behavior.

papers.title: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
papers.ko_title: Softmax와 Cross-Entropy의 숨은 수치 버그를 바로잡는 구현
papers.summary: 표준 softmax·log-softmax·cross-entropy 구현에 있는 두 가지 수치 버그(Softmax Collapse, Softmax Cancellation)를 찾아내고, 이를 고치는 간단한 구현으로 Slingshot 현상을 없애고 grokking을 앞당깁니다.
papers.abstract: Standard implementations of softmax, log-softmax, and cross-entropy have two numerical bugs. The first bug, Softmax Collapse, rounds the target logit's gradient to zero if that one logit is much larger than the others, resulting in gradients that no longer sum to zero. The second bug, Softmax Cancellation, occurs when student logits are close to teacher logits, and produces non-zero gradients even when the student and teacher logits are equal. We present simple implementations of log-softmax, softmax, and cross-entropy that fix both bugs. Our fix eliminates the previously-observed "Slingshot" phenomenon, speeds up grokking with weight decay, prevents accuracy collapse without weight decay, stops student networks from drifting away from the teacher during distillation, and shows that after memorization, logit growth is bounded by an equilibrium between weight decay and Adam's $ε$ hyperparameter.

papers.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
papers.ko_title: 언어 모델의 N-gram 임베딩 테이블을 저비트로 압축하기
papers.summary: DeepSeek Engram처럼 수천억 파라미터를 차지하는 n-gram 임베딩 테이블을 낮은 정밀도로 저장해, 성능 이득은 유지하면서 메모리 비용을 크게 줄이는 양자화 방법과 테이블별 비트 배분을 체계적으로 분석합니다.
papers.abstract: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.

papers.title: Who Is Sycophantic to Whom? Confident LLMs, Human Deference, and the Collapse of Trust Calibration
papers.ko_title: 누가 누구에게 아첨하는가 확신에 찬 LLM 앞에서 무너지는 사람의 신뢰 보정
papers.summary: LLM이 확신에 차서 일관되게 틀린 정보를 말할 때 사용자가 오히려 그 주장에 따르는지를 피험자 내 실험으로 검증하고, 이 과정에서 사람의 신뢰 보정이 무너진다는 사실을 보여줍니다.
papers.abstract: Research on sycophancy asks whether large language models (LLMs) bend towards what their users want to hear. We ask the reverse question: when an LLM is confident, consistent, and wrong, do users bend towards it? In a within-subjects experiment, 32 participants learned up to five science topics by chatting with five assistants built on the same model (GPT-5-mini). Unknown to participants, each assistant's briefing had 0, 25, 50, 75, or 100% of its facts replaced by plausible falsehoods, and every assistant spoke with full confidence. A surprise quiz after each topic offered the correct fact, the planted falsehood, and two distractors, with a confidence rating for every answer. Across 104 quizzes and 1,040 answers, scores fell from 7.4 to 2.9 out of 10, and the planted option was chosen on 60% of falsified items against 11% of correctly taught ones (odds ratio 12.5). Transcript coding showed that whenever the assistant stated a falsehood, it was adopted about 65% of the time at every falsification level. Absorbed falsehoods were held with high confidence (8.4/10), the modeled confidence advantage of right over wrong answers vanished, and the discrimination of confidence for correctness fell from an AUROC of 0.70 to chance, while post-task trust ratings barely moved. Participants tended to return to the chat more when the assistant was worse, but returning went with more absorption, not less, and 30% of all turns pasted quiz questions back to the source being checked. The assistant itself was almost never sycophantic and never conceded under pushback. We introduce a baseline-corrected Human Deference Index to quantify this human-side sycophancy and argue that trustworthiness is a property of the human-AI pair, that sycophancy evaluations should measure both directions, and that learning interfaces must make reliability legible claim by claim.

papers.title: The Delegation Divide: An Open Index of AI-Agent Delegability across Occupations and Countries
papers.ko_title: 위임 격차 146개국 직업별 AI 에이전트 위임 가능성 공개 지수
papers.summary: O*NET 과업 18,796개를 사전 등록된 기준으로 평가해 146개국의 AI 에이전트 위임 가능성을 측정하는 공개 지수(ADI)를 구축하고, 2026년 전 세계 근로시간의 35.2%가 일부라도 위임 가능하며 소득이 높은 나라일수록 그 비중이 커지는 '위임 격차'가 있음을 보입니다.
papers.abstract: 35.2% of task time in world employment is at least partly delegable to AI agents in 2026, and only 2.5% can be handed over in full. Existing measures score exposure to generative AI, mostly for the United States. We build the Agent Delegability Index (ADI): two language models rate all 18,796 O*NET 30.2 task statements on a frozen, preregistered rubric of delegation levels and barriers; tasks are mapped to 433 ISCO-08 unit groups and weighted by ILOSTAT employment in 146 countries. Four findings. First, delegable employment rises with income, from 22.5% in low-income to 48.7% in high-income countries, a slope of 7.23 percentage points per log point of GDP per capita. This delegation divide is compositional: the physical barrier dominates the jobs poorer countries employ most. Second, at the occupation level ADI tracks exposure closely (r = 0.93 with Eloundou et al. and 0.89 with Felten et al.), above the preregistered bound of 0.80; ADI adds delegation levels and barriers on top of exposure, for the world, not a new ranking of occupations. Third, full delegation is rare and peaks for tasks that take a human about twelve minutes (11.8 minutes). Fourth, the preregistered adoption gap is not supported: across 101 countries, delegability and observed AI usage correlate at r = 0.86, and the gap between them is not wider in middle-income countries (p = 0.27). Model agreement is kappa = 0.77; a blind human rating of 300 tasks agrees with the model consensus at kappa = 0.85, and an agentic panel with web search at kappa = 0.87. We release the index, the atlas, the prompts and an MCP server at https://github.com/Cespial/delegation-divide.

papers.title: Stronger artificial intelligence breakthroughs hasten their own exhaustion
papers.ko_title: 강력한 AI 돌파구는 스스로 고갈을 앞당긴다
papers.summary: 36년간 컴퓨터과학 논문 720만 편과 연구자 370만 명을 분석해, 트랜스포머 이후 연구자의 관심이 AI로 쏠리면서 돌파구에 필요한 다양한 관심이 줄어들고 혁신 동력이 스스로 소진될 수 있음을 실증합니다.
papers.abstract: Progress in artificial intelligence is widely assumed to scale with effort: more researchers, papers and investment should accelerate discovery. Theories of technological growth instead locate the difficulty of discovery in the space of ideas. Here we show that neither scale nor space is enough: breakthroughs depend on diverse attention, which collective concentration can deplete. Across 36 years of computer science, we analyze 7.2 million papers, 73,089 peer reviews and 3.7 million researchers and their topic shifts. The field expanded while its attention narrowed sharply after the Transformer. Over half of topic-shifting researchers moved into AI, especially mid-career ones, and reviewer confidence fell by a full point on a 5-point scale. Each successive breakthrough, from AlexNet to large language models, raised the field's carrying capacity for ideas but was followed by steeper exhaustion of those ideas. Bigger breakthroughs capture attention more completely, depleting the diversity their successors may draw upon. Structural biology shows the same cycle after cryo-EM and AlphaFold. Simulations show how well-intentioned and widely used policies such as reciprocal reviewing empower prolific authors and further narrow what the field accepts. We call for institutions that protect diverse attention in artificial intelligence rather than reward concentration on the winning paradigm.

papers.title: Causal inference in staggered adoption panels: The correct comparison set depends on your intervention
papers.ko_title: 시차 도입 패널의 인과추론 올바른 비교군은 개입의 성격에 따라 달라진다
papers.summary: 이중차분법·고정효과·합성통제처럼 시차 도입 패널에서 널리 쓰는 방법들이 실제로는 서로 다른 두 인과 질문을 섞고 있음을 밝히고, 분석하려는 개입에 따라 비교군을 달리 잡아야 한다는 점을 보입니다.
papers.abstract: A powerful data structure for causal inference is staggered adoption: many units are observed over many time periods, during which some units adopt an irreversible treatment at various time points while others remain untreated. Popular methods that apply in this setting include difference in difference, fixed effects, matching, and synthetic control. All of these methods compare the future outcomes of treatment adopters and non-adopters to answer the question: for units who adopt treatment, what outcomes would have been realized if they had remained untreated? We show that this question actually hides two very different causal questions of interest. The first is what would have happened under a momentary intervention to prevent treatment at its factual adoption time. The second is what would have happened to a treated unit under a longitudinal ban preventing treatment at all periods until outcome measurement. We show how to answer each question under conditionally ignorable treatment adoption or under parallel trends. We highlight that common methods cannot answer the second question because this question requires a time-varying comparison set with time-varying weights.

papers.title: RiboBridge: protein-conditioned de novo RNA binder structure design
papers.ko_title: RiboBridge 표적 단백질에 맞춰 결합하는 RNA 구조를 처음부터 설계하는 프레임워크
papers.summary: RNA 형태 생성과 단백질-RNA 조립 단계를 분리하고, 결합 부위를 미리 정하지 않은 채 단백질 표면에서 결합 후보 부위를 먼저 제안하는 방식으로 단백질에 결합하는 RNA를 새로 설계합니다.
papers.abstract: Designing RNA molecules that bind to target protein structures requires generating both an RNA conformation and its bound complex geometry, without assuming a predefined binding site. Existing approaches generally model these coupled processes within a unified representation, entangling RNA conformation generation with protein-relative placement. In this work, we introduce RiboBridge, a structure-first framework that separates RNA conformational generation from protein--RNA assembly through cross-frame interaction geometry. RiboBridge first proposes multiple candidate RNA-binding interfaces on the protein surface, generates canonical RNA conformations within a pretrained RNA structural latent space (RiboSphere), and then predicts protein--RNA interaction constraints to bridge the independently defined RNA and protein coordinate frames. The resulting interaction geometry is converted into a geometrically consistent protein-relative pose through rigid placement. We evaluate RiboBridge on a temporally split, sequence-filtered, and redundancy-controlled benchmark of 124 protein--RNA complexes. Under post-hoc interface-correspondence evaluation, where native information is used only after generation to select among already generated predicted-pocket candidates, RiboBridge achieves the highest fNAT and DockQ and the lowest interface and ligand RMSDs among compared methods. Component ablations and stage-wise diagnostics further characterize the contributions of RNA conformational generation, interaction prediction, and rigid placement, identifying the main sources of complex-recovery error.

papers.title: EMBER: Predicting TCR--pMHC Binding Without a Docked Complex
papers.ko_title: EMBER 도킹 복합체 없이 TCR과 펩타이드-MHC 결합을 예측하는 방법
papers.summary: TCR과 pMHC를 각각 따로 접어 SE(3) 불변 잔기 그래프로 표현하고 두 표현을 비교하는 방식으로, 공동 접힘 복합체를 만들 때 생기는 배치 오차 없이 면역 결합을 예측합니다.
papers.abstract: We propose EMBER, a structure-based framework for TCR--pMHC binding prediction that eliminates the need for a predicted docked complex, and with it the placement error that dominates such predictions. Traditional structure-based predictors utilize the co-folded complex structure of the receptor and the antigen and interpret binding from its contact surface. Consequently, every downstream feature inherits any deviation the structure-prediction tool introduced. Methodologically, EMBER folds the TCR and pMHC independently, encodes them as SE(3)-invariant residue graphs, and compares their learned representations without constructing a shared coordinate frame. A relative pose is therefore not an input of the model, so placement error cannot propagate into the prediction. Computationally, EMBER preprocesses $O(N{+}M)$ monomer folds where a complex-based predictor needs $O(NM)$ operations. Experimentally, under epitope-disjoint evaluation with six retrained baselines, EMBER is first on every metric under all four folding tools, by 0.9 to 14.4% in micro-AUROC, 18.5 to 25.3% in micro-AUPRC and 10.6 to 24.1% in MCC. Its ranking is also up to 85% more stable across folding tools.

papers.title: Supercoiling Drives DNA-Protein Co-Condensation
papers.ko_title: DNA 초나선이 DNA와 단백질의 공동 응축을 이끄는 원리
papers.summary: DNA 탄성 모델을 단백질 농도장과 결합해, 전사·복제 과정에서 생기는 초나선이 단백질 젖음과 서로 강화하며 DNA-단백질 응축을 촉진하는 위상학적 촉매로 작용함을 보입니다.
papers.abstract: The co-condensation of DNA and proteins plays an important role in genome compaction, including heterochromatin formation and chromosome segregation. Meanwhile, transcription and replication continuously generate DNA supercoiling, yet how the resulting torsional stress affects co-condensation remains poorly understood. Here, by coupling DNA elasticity to a protein concentration field, we show that supercoiling acts as a topological catalyst for co-condensation through a mutually reinforcing interplay with protein wetting. Specifically, protein wetting facilitates twist-to-writhe conversion, generating highly writhed DNA conformations that in turn promote capillary collapse into a protein-rich droplet. In the absence of supercoiling, DNA remains kinetically trapped in metastable extended states within our model, whereas sufficiently strong supercoiling removes the nucleation barrier and enables spontaneous co-condensation. These results establish topology as a distinct control parameter for biomolecular condensation and provide a mechanical framework for how active genomic processes can dynamically regulate large-scale genome organization.

papers.title: Extreme competition between stripes and superconductivity in the hole-doped Hubbard model
papers.ko_title: 홀 도핑 Hubbard 모델에서 줄무늬 질서와 초전도의 극한 경쟁
papers.summary: 신경망 텐서 네트워크와 신경 backflow 상태를 대규모 GPU로 계산해 최대 1024개 사이트 격자에서 전례 없는 변분 정확도를 얻고, 구리산화물 초전도의 최소 모델에서 줄무늬 질서와 d파 초전도가 거의 같은 에너지로 경쟁함을 보여 줍니다.
papers.abstract: The two-dimensional Hubbard model was originally proposed as the minimal model of uniform $d$-wave superconductivity in the cuprate high-temperature superconductors, but recent calculations with relevant parameters in a realistic doping regime have often found other ground states. Further, uncertainty remains over such results due to the intrinsic bias of different computational methods. Here we address this uncertainty through state-of-the-art neural tensor network and neural backflow state simulations, enabled by large-scale GPU computation, that together reach an unprecedented variational accuracy on lattices with up to 1024 sites. At $1/8$ doping in the pure Hubbard model, as well as with next-nearest-neighbor hopping relevant to the hole-doped cuprates, we reveal a near degeneracy among a low-energy uniform $d$-wave state, superconducting stripes, and non-superconducting stripe states on the milli-$t$ energy scale. Our work rebalances the narrative that the Hubbard model supports a single dominant order in relevant parameter regimes towards a picture of extreme competition between stripes and superconductivity.

papers.title: The limits of magic-state distillation
papers.ko_title: 매직 상태 증류의 근본적 한계
papers.summary: 적응형·사후선택·다단계 방식을 포함한 어떤 안정자 증류 프로토콜도 하나의 안정자 부호로의 사영보다 나을 수 없음을 증명하고, T 상태의 2차 증류에는 입력이 정확히 9개 필요하며 입력 8개짜리 CCZ 공장이 최적임을 밝힙니다.
papers.abstract: Magic-state factories are a major cost of fault-tolerant quantum computing, yet how few noisy inputs they need is known only for restricted protocols. We show that, for tolerating input faults, any stabilizer protocol, however adaptive, postselected or multistage, is no better than a projection onto one stabilizer code, and that for rational targets a fault pattern is harmful exactly when its complement is. Searches over all codes show that quadratic distillation of one T state needs exactly nine inputs and that the eight-input CCZ factory is optimal. At order $d$, one T state needs $n\geq2d$.

papers.title: Realization of a Superleak in a Quantum Gas
papers.ko_title: 양자 기체에서 초누출 구현
papers.summary: 광학 초격자의 동역학적 선택성을 이용해 초유체만 조셉슨 수송으로 통과시키고 정상 성분은 억제하는 초누출을 처음 구현하며, 유량 대비 500배의 차이로 초유체를 반복해 정제하는 데 성공합니다.
papers.abstract: Ultracold quantum gases offer a controllable and microscopically accessible platform for understanding and engineering superfluidity. Yet, realizing a superleak that selectively transports the superfluid while suppressing normal flow has remained elusive. Here, we harness an optical superlattice to realize such a superleak through dynamical selectivity. The superfluid undergoes coherent Josephson transport, whereas the normal component exhibits slow, thermodynamically limited response, resulting in a flow-rate contrast of 500(49). Exploiting this contrast, we demonstrate repeated filtering of the normal component and dynamical purification of the superfluid, while sustaining coherent driven oscillations for up to 100 cycles. Our results establish a controllable atomic superleak and open possibilities for manipulating transport and thermodynamics in quantum fluids.

papers.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
papers.ko_title: Gemini 4 Argon 에이전트 4대, 협업만으로 마인크래프트 엔더 드래곤 처치
papers.summary: 역할 배정이나 게임 로직 없이 Gemini 4 Argon 에이전트 4대가 채팅과 공유 메모리로 협업해 프로그램 2,783개를 직접 작성·디버깅하고, 27시간 14분 만에 마인크래프트 엔더 드래곤을 처치했습니다.
papers.abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.

papers.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
papers.ko_title: 대규모 언어모델로 최고 성능의 양자 회로를 찾아내다
papers.summary: LLM이 회로 설계를 제안하고 독립 평가기가 검증·채점하는 진화적 프레임워크를 제안해, 가역성 제약이 걸린 핵심 연산 프리미티브에서 최고 수준의 양자 회로를 찾아냈습니다.
papers.abstract: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.

papers.title: Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It
papers.ko_title: 미세조정 전에 선형으로 표현된 지식만 미세조정 뒤에도 일반화된다
papers.summary: 언어모델이 기억하는 사실을 일반화를 돕는 '활성 사실'과 회상만 되는 '비활성 사실'로 나누고, 사전학습 표현에서 선형으로 읽히는 지식일수록 미세조정 뒤 새 관계로 잘 일반화된다는 점을 보였습니다.
papers.abstract: Not all facts a language model can recall support further learning equally well. We distinguish active facts, which support generalization beyond their own recall, from inert facts, which can be recalled but do not support such generalization in a given task. We study this distinction by constructing new relations from existing ones. Take the relation that maps a place to its continent (Paris -> Europe) and assign each of its answers an arbitrary new label (Europe -> crab, Asia -> zebra). The new relation then maps Paris -> crab. We fine-tune the model on the new relation for a subset of subjects, without telling it the original relation or the relabeling rule, and test whether it assigns the corresponding labels to held-out subjects that share an answer in the original relation. Having learned Paris -> crab, does it answer Munich -> crab? Across eleven language models and 70 relations, how linearly readable the original relation is in pretrained representations strongly predicts this generalization. Within each model, the two correlate across relations at Pearson r = 0.87 to 0.92. This association persists when controlling, separately and jointly, for the number of fine-tuning subjects and answers, the model's accuracy on the original relation, and how often the subjects occur in pretraining text. It is also robust to re-randomizing the label assignment and fine-tuning seed, and to replacing the animal labels with labels from thirteen other semantic categories. When we map a fine-tuned model's wrong label back to the original answer it was assigned to, Munich -> zebra becomes Munich -> Asia. Answers recovered this way are more often among the linear probe's top answers for the subject than among the pretrained model's own. Whether a new relation generalizes depends less on whether its facts can be recalled than on how readily their shared structure can be read out linearly.

papers.title: Creative destruction: Human-AI competition in an experimental market
papers.ko_title: 창조적 파괴 실험 시장에서 벌어진 인간과 AI의 경쟁
papers.summary: 참가자 1,025명이 참여한 세 차례 실험에서 AI 혼자 설계한 게임이 아마추어와 전문 창작자 모두의 게임보다 성과가 좋았고, 인간의 '취향 우위'나 소비자의 '인간 제작 선호'를 뒷받침하는 증거는 찾지 못했습니다.
papers.abstract: We study two hypotheses for how a human role in production could persist despite growing AI capabilities. Humans might have a durable advantage in taste, designing better products even as AI agents automate routine tasks, or consumers might intrinsically prefer that humans have a hand in production. In our experiment, participants act as producers, designing computer games with an AI coding agent, and as consumers who buy them. Across three studies (N = 1,025), we find no evidence for either hypothesis. Games designed by an AI on its own outperform those of human producers, including both amateurs and professional creatives. Human producers do not anticipate the AI's advantage. Revealing whether a game is human-designed does not raise consumers' willingness to pay for the product.

papers.title: How Well Do LLMs Perform in Peer Review? Evidence from Finance and Accounting
papers.ko_title: LLM은 심사위원 역할을 얼마나 잘할까 재무·회계 학계의 증거
papers.summary: GPT-4o가 2024년 AFA·NBER 학회 논문을 심사하게 한 결과, 모델 점수가 1표준편차 높은 논문은 저자 명성을 통제해도 3대 재무 저널 게재 확률이 44% 높았으며 이 예측력은 미래 정보 유출이 아니라 논문의 정확성 판단에서 나온다는 점을 보였습니다.
papers.abstract: Referees increasingly use large language models (LLMs), while finance and accounting journals disagree about whether to allow it. We ask which part of a referee's job the models can do. GPT-4o, whose training data end before the 2024 conference season, referees the papers presented at the 2024 AFA and NBER finance meetings, and we compare its verdicts with publication in the top-three finance journals over the next two years. Papers the model scores one standard deviation higher are 44\% more likely to be published, net of author reputation. The result is not driven by look-ahead bias, as the model does not recall the outcomes. The information comes from its judgements of correctness and exposition. Its judgements of originality and significance carry none, and a referee guide that stresses importance does not help. The split between correctness and contribution holds for accounting papers and for a newer model, GPT-5. LLMs can check whether research is right, but not whether it matters. The technical check can go to the model, while the judgement of contribution stays with people.

papers.title: Locally Robust Inference with Outcomes Predicted by Machine Learning
papers.ko_title: 머신러닝으로 예측한 결과변수를 쓸 때의 국소 강건 추론
papers.summary: 머신러닝이 만든 결과변수를 관측값처럼 쓰는 계량경제 분석에서 추론이 왜곡되는 문제를 바로잡기 위해, 동태적 처치효과·대리변수 기반 장기효과·생산성 추정 등에 두루 적용할 수 있는 3단계 국소 강건 GMM 틀을 제시합니다.
papers.abstract: Many parameters of interest in economics depend on outcomes generated by machine learning (ML).These generated outcomes are subsequently used in standard econometric estimation and typically treated as observed, a practice that threatens the validity of downstream inference. Empirically relevant cases include dynamic treatment effects under sequential exogeneity, long-term effects with surrogates, the partially linear model with an ML-predicted outcome, productivity persistence with an unrestricted production function and constructed instruments, and outcomes residualized of confounding variation. This paper develops a three-step locally robust GMM framework for valid inference when the dependent variable is generated by ML. We construct a debiased moment condition that augments the identifying moment with first- and second-step influence functions, making inference on the parameter of interest locally insensitive to regularization and model selection biases at both steps. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimator and illustrate its finite-sample performance through Monte Carlo simulations. We also apply the method to U.S. mortgage data to study conditional Black--White disparities in a race-blind ML default-risk score. The score predicts subsequent default well overall, but the conditional disparity embedded in the score is much smaller than the corresponding disparity in realized serious delinquency; accounting for first-step estimation also raises the naive out-of-sample estimate of the score disparity.

papers.title: Panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes at scale with CellNet
papers.ko_title: CellNet DNA 유전자 정보와 RNA 발현을 하나의 이미지 표현으로 통합한 대규모 단일세포 파운데이션 모델
papers.summary: DNA 기반 유전자 정체성과 측정된 RNA 발현을 공유 이미지 표현으로 통합하고 40개 종의 세포 프로필 2억 3,100만 개로 사전학습해, 단일세포 전사체를 폭넓게 모델링하는 파운데이션 모델을 제시합니다.
papers.abstract: Comprehensively characterizing cellular diversity is critical for understanding tissue development, identifying disease-associated populations and investigating gene programmes linked to specialized functions. Advances in single-cell profiling reveal additional cell-specific transcripts and molecular associations, yet many foundation models represent only a restricted portion of this increasingly rich molecular information. Here we present CellNet, which enables panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes by integrating DNA-derived gene identities and measured RNA expression in a shared image representation. Pretrained on 231 million cell profiles spanning 40 species, CellNet improves rare-population and condition-associated state recognition in evaluated cohorts while retaining competitive general cell representations. It predicts withheld coding-gene expression and selected non-coding targets in total-RNA data, and recovers lineage-specific expression patterns in spatial measurements. Prediction also extends across species, including to targets without expression-pretraining exposure. Its gene representations retrieve known non-coding modules and developmental or neural programmes, including from sparsely detected RNA queries. Together, these results establish CellNet as a scalable framework for interpreting cellular diversity through increasingly comprehensive transcriptomic measurements.

papers.title: Poisoning the corpora of protein design systems during pre-training and retrieval
papers.ko_title: 단백질 설계 AI의 사전학습·검색 코퍼스를 겨냥한 데이터 오염 공격
papers.summary: ProtGPT2·ProGen2 계열 단백질 언어모델과 텍스트 기반 단백질 생성기의 학습·검색 데이터에 트리거 서열을 심어 백도어를 만들 수 있음을 보여, 바이오 AI의 보안 취약성을 드러냅니다.
papers.abstract: Protein foundation models increasingly support the generation of novel biological sequences, yet their reliance on large public datasets creates opportunities for adversarial manipulation of the material they learn from and retrieve. We investigate two data-only poisoning attacks against protein design systems, targeting the pre-training corpus of autoregressive protein language models and the retrieval corpus of a text-guided protein generator. For the first, we pre-trained ProtGPT2 and ProGen2 variants of 300 million parameters, introducing poisoned protein sequences containing one of two triggers followed by one of three payloads. Across all poisoned runs, both architectures acquired highly reliable trigger-dependent generation under uniform and ramped poisoning schedules. Under ramped exposure, the earliest majority activation occurred after only 200 contaminated examples, while for the uniform schedule earliest activation occurred around 5000 poisoned samples. For the second attack, we inserted records into a retrieval corpus system without modifying its weights or decoding procedure. A single query-aware record captured a top-16 retrieval position for 58\% of templated requests and 97\% of free-text requests. Conditional on successful poisoned retrieval, 62\% of requests produced altered sequences, while 19-21% acquired the inserted domain by profile-HMM homology. A universal query-unaware attack using 1,500 records also achieved substantial retrieval capture and domain transfer. Together, these findings demonstrate that adversarial protein sequence contributions can establish persistent, sequence-specific behaviour during pre-training or redirect protein generation at inference, while leaving ordinary model behaviour largely preserved. Our work establishes the integrity and biological provenance of protein sequence data as critical safeguards for generative protein design systems.

papers.title: Mutual Information in High-Dimensional Neural Coding
papers.ko_title: 고차원 신경 부호의 상호정보량 추정과 집단 크기 스케일링 법칙
papers.summary: 몬테카를로 방법으로 최대 1만 개 뉴런 집단의 상호정보량을 추정해, 시각피질·해마·망막 전반에서 뉴런 수가 늘수록 자극 불확실성이 지수적으로 줄어드는 공통 스케일링 법칙을 밝힙니다.
papers.abstract: Estimating mutual information in large neural populations is limited by the exponential growth of possible neural response patterns. Here we apply a Monte Carlo framework to make this problem tractable by sampling from a conditionally independent population model fit from single-neuron responses. The estimator accurately recovers analytical ground truth, corrects finite-data bias, and scales to empirical recordings containing 100 to 10,000 neurons from visual cortex, hippocampus, and retina. Across systems, stimulus uncertainty decays exponentially with population size, revealing a simple scaling law for high-dimensional neural codes.

papers.title: Classical Capacity of Single-Mode Bosonic Gaussian Channels
papers.ko_title: 단일 모드 보손 가우시안 채널의 고전 용량 완전 규명
papers.summary: 모든 단일 모드 보손 가우시안 채널에서 에너지 제약 Holevo 정보가 가산적이고 가우시안 부호화가 최적임을 증명해 광통신 채널의 고전 정보 전송 한계라는 오랜 미해결 문제를 해결합니다.
papers.abstract: The classical capacity of a noisy optical channel is the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted reliably, given a constraint on the mean input energy. For the ubiquitous bosonic Gaussian channels, which include standard models of loss and noise in fibre and free-space optical links, determining this rate requires addressing whether entanglement between channel uses or non-Gaussian signals can outperform Gaussian encodings. More precisely, the question is whether the energy-constrained Holevo information is additive across arbitrarily many channel uses and coincides with its Gaussian counterpart. We answer these fundamental questions in the affirmative for every single-mode bosonic Gaussian channel at every input energy. Namely, we prove that independently prepared Gaussian states with Gaussian-distributed random displacements achieve the capacity, including in the low-energy regime where squeezing the signals competes with encoding information in their displacement. Our proof connects an entanglement inequality to a sharp, additive lower bound on output entropy. We then characterise communication above capacity: under a strict total photon-number cutoff, the probability of correct decoding decreases exponentially with the number of channel uses, and we derive explicit bounds on the decay exponent. When only the mean photon number is constrained, a simple energy-rescaling formula determines exactly the entire asymptotic rate--error trade-off: the capacity at mean photon number $N$ and allowed average decoding error $ε$ equals the vanishing-error capacity at mean photon number $N/(1-ε)$. Together, these results identify the ultimate limits of classical communication for some of the most fundamental models of optical communication.

papers.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
papers.ko_title: 대규모 언어 모델로 최고 성능의 양자 회로를 찾아내다
papers.summary: LLM이 회로 설계를 제안하고 독립 평가기가 검증·채점하는 진화적 프레임워크를 도입해 양자 알고리즘의 핵심 연산 요소에서 기존 최고 수준의 회로를 발견합니다.
papers.abstract: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.

papers.title: One generation of the Standard Model as a quantum error-correcting code
papers.ko_title: 양자 오류정정 부호로 본 표준모형 한 세대
papers.summary: 표준모형 한 세대 페르미온의 아노말리 상쇄 조건이 매직 상태 증류에 쓰이는 삼직교 부호의 정의와 같다는 점을 보여 입자물리와 양자 오류정정 사이의 뜻밖의 대응을 밝힙니다.
papers.abstract: Together with a right-handed neutrino, the fermions of one generation of the Standard Model are labelled by five bits, a combinatorial structure tied to anomaly cancellation. We make this precise. Anomaly cancellation is the vanishing of a cubic form, the defining property of triorthogonal codes, the quantum error-correcting codes behind magic state distillation. Removing the right-handed neutrino gives a $[[15,1,3]]_p$ code for every prime $p$, including the Bravyi-Kitaev code for $p = 2$. For qutrits it is the unique shortest distance-three triorthogonal code.

papers.title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
papers.ko_title: 현장 적발 프로브로 LLM 에이전트의 사보타주와 말로 드러나지 않는 기만 탐지하기
papers.summary: 역대 최대 규모의 기만 데이터셋과 여러 층·토큰의 정보를 종합하는 새 프로브 구조로 SHADE-Arena에서 98.8% AUC를 달성해 Opus 5.5 텍스트 모니터링 기준선을 넘어섰음을 보입니다.
papers.abstract: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

papers.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
papers.ko_title: AI 시간 지평 추정은 타당한가 METR 그래프의 통계적 재검토
papers.summary: 228개 과제와 26개 AI를 스플라인과 문항반응이론으로 재분석해 인간 소요 시간 2~30분 구간에서는 AI 난이도가 거의 평탄하므로 같은 10배 도약이라도 구간에 따라 어려움이 크게 다르다는 점을 밝힙니다.
papers.abstract: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.

papers.title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
papers.ko_title: AI 연구의 월드 모델로서의 언어 모델
